description: This file defines the 'Config' class within the Opencart System Engine namespace, responsible for managing configuration paths, loading configuration data from PHP files, and providing getter/setter access to configuration parameters in an OpenCart project.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Handles configuration paths, loading configuration data, and managing configuration parameters.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a directory path for a specific namespace or sets the main directory if no directory is provided.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key, returning an empty string if not set.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for a specific key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration key exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a PHP file based on the filename, merging it into existing data.
